description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of character types used in the ChARM framework, categorizing them into two main groups: Virtual Characters and Real Characters. The largest segment, representing Virtual Characters, is further divided into subcategories including Movie Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, and Game Characters, all depicted in various shades of blue. The Real Characters category, shown in green, includes subcategories such as Scientists, Artists, Athletes, Writers, Musicians, Actors, and Influencers. A small red segment labeled Custom Characters is also present, indicating a distinct category. The chart uses a color-coded system to differentiate between the various character types, with the largest portion of the pie dedicated to Virtual Characters, followed by the Real Characters, and a smaller portion for Custom Characters. The visual representation emphasizes the diversity and breadth of character types considered in the ChARM framework.
